query:
INSERT INTO workspace_space (workspace_id, space_id)
           SELECT w.id, s.id
           FROM workspace w
           JOIN space s ON s.id = $3
           WHERE w.id = $2 AND w.user_id = $1 AND s.user_id = $1
           ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, space_id) DO NOTHING
           RETURNING workspace_id, space_id
